title: Orchestrated region-tier routing refactor with safe fallback contracts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Refactor the policy engine responsible for selecting region, tier, and fallback model variants so that routing rules are validated against a typed schema before they reach the dispatcher. Goals: (1) introduce a gradual-compatibility migration path for existing customer configs, (2) provide deterministic error messages and actionable linting for common misconfigurations, (3) add testable contracts for fallbacks so that canary rollouts cannot create silent behavior changes. This work touches the intake/parser, typed IR, validator, and the runtime-bound compatibility shim used by Dedicated and Private deployments. The refactor must preserve runtime performance (no extra 1ms p95 per request) and enable static analysis for rollout automation.
acceptance_criteria: New declarative schema (OpenAPI + custom rules) exists and is documented in confluence: /docs/smart-routing/schema-v2
Intake layer rejects unsupported or ambiguous constructs with clear remediation hints (linting output)
Typed IR emits a canonical normalized rule representation and unit tests cover 95% of rule transformation logic
Backward-compatibility mode available: legacy-configs can opt-in to strict validation; migration tool emits patch suggestions
E2E integration tests exercising region/tier priority, weighted regional routing, and fallback model substitution pass in CI with the new validator enabled
No regression in latency SLOs measured by perf benchmark harness (p50/p95 within 2% of baseline)
